rv.q: ★★★★ "It's the oldest strategy in the dramatic playbook: the 'retrospective' plot, in which a buried secret is dug up and brought into the light...That's why Bess Wohl's 'Make Believe ' has such freshness: The writer has found a new way to cut old cloth."
★★★★ "'A Sentimental but Not Syrupy Nostalgia Trip.' Children of the '80s will especially enjoy Bess Wohl's nostalgic new play, set in a memory-filled family attic"
